race.comment: SAVANNAH CHILL (1) brings the most reliable winning profile, having put together two straight victories and now returning to a trip where her record is excellent. She's adaptable and draws for a soft run, she'll be hard to beat again. DIAMOND EYE (5) is the main danger if the Sale run in harder company is forgiven, with interference late in a BM70 and a Seymour win the start prior keeping her right in calculations. LADY THINKABELL (9) resumes off a Ballarat trial and owns the stronger back-form, including a narrow BM66 second at Morphettville before tackling the Listed Centaurea Stakes. Respecting. CELESTIAL SPLENDOR (11) rises from a dominant Kilmore BM56 win, and the way she scored by three lengths third-up says she can measure up. ROYAL EMBLEM (2) has an interesting profile and is one to watch.
